representations.name: Exact promotion-coordinate lattice
representations.new_information: Retains the exact promotion count c and both rank-two remainders r,u through b=cq+binom(c,2)+u-r+1, instead of fixing c before q grows.
representations.first_test: Enumerate exact admissible tuples beyond c=5 and verify parity, b<h, gamma3<0, and x>=0 without extrapolating the finite box.

representations.name: Full borrow-aware Macaulay word
representations.new_information: Keeps every leading index, lower remainder, borrow depth, and wall crossing in the two low blocks; it distinguishes states having the same borrow signs but different recovery behavior.
representations.first_test: Replay the K=6,r=10 dyadic family and the five positive rank-five chambers with one engine and check that their full words, not merely their signs, separate them.

representations.name: Coupled cap-depth coordinates
representations.new_information: Represents each deficit by its least cap depth and canonical remainder, retaining the relative correction h_D-h_E that controlled the fixed-c=2 critical ellipse.
representations.first_test: Compute exact depth gaps on all frozen multi-promotion states and search for m=2 or reversed-depth phases when c grows.

representations.name: Growing-c normalized phase space
representations.new_information: Tracks c/sqrt(q), r/q, u/(q+c), leading-index ratios, and lower-order boundary scales, so sequences with c=c(q) are not discarded by fixed-c compactness.
representations.first_test: Derive all subsequential regimes c=o(sqrt(q)), c comparable to sqrt(q), and the x-boundary, and test whether gamma4 can have a nonpositive limiting profile.

representations.name: Primal/dual full-block loss cone
representations.new_information: Keeps both the positive remainder and the complementary full-block deficit, allowing matching lower certificates rather than one lossy superadditivity projection.
representations.first_test: Form the exact gamma4 comparator in both remainder and deficit coordinates and solve for an inequality combination that stays positive on the two old residual rows and c>=6 witnesses.

representations.name: Borrow-aware transition graph
representations.new_information: Encodes a state by promotion count, ordered cap depths, leading gaps, and normalized remainders, with edges given by exact raising; negative rows can be followed adaptively rather than forced positive immediately.
representations.first_test: Build the reachable graph through the first three transitions for exact counterfamilies and reject any signature quotient that merges states with different exits.

representations.name: Lexicographic recovery potential
representations.new_information: Records ordered borrow depth together with normalized deficit per leading gap, so a negative transition may still certify strict improvement before rank 42.
representations.first_test: Evaluate the potential on b=5, b=L/2+5, and K=6,r=10 families; require strict ascent at every negative step and a uniform upper bound.

representations.name: Seed-to-rank capacity flow network
representations.new_information: Represents each candidate diagonal seed as supply and each legal occupied rank as capacity, explicitly retaining collisions and borrow-induced demand omitted by the relaxed no-borrow model.
representations.first_test: Construct the smallest exact relaxed-positive instances whose seed assignment violates actual rank capacity, then compute the Hall-deficient cut.

representations.name: Exceptional-signature injection
representations.new_information: Treats each nonpositive signature as an object that must be injected into a distinct later legal rank, preserving the global rank budget instead of proving a false fixed-delay statement.
representations.first_test: On all known infinite counterfamilies, map each negative signature to its first recovery rank and test injectivity and rank-42 compatibility.

representations.name: Exact transition comparator interface
representations.new_information: Separates original-lattice membership, canonical signature, exact transition, and claimed exit, so Python or Lean probes cannot silently replace the public bridge by a relaxed statement.
representations.first_test: Reproduce a frozen counterexample and a positive chamber with independent canonical engines under bounded resources and compare every interface predicate.
